In their sights is #Inacio, born in 2008, who has a contract until 2029, but the pressure has begun to ramp up. The strategy focusing on young Italian players also includes #Ndour, a very uphill path because #Fiorentina considers him non-transferable, and #Lipani from #Sassuolo. The maneuvers have not yet entered the heat of the action, but #Juventus is already more than operational.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

#BayernMunich is getting serious about the ex #Juve #KaioJorge: according to Brazilian sources, at the end of the South American country's season (December), the German club would launch an assault for the #Cruzeiro center-forward with an offer of 45 million euros to have him available starting January 1st. #Juventus is watching closely as they possess a 30% sell-on clause on any future resale.[Mirko Nicolino]

His absence, though, spreads responsibility across everyone because he’s always attentive to everything. This week I’ve seen a team that’s very willing to fight against whatever it comes up against, a team that’s trained very well.“Because of the individual pressure players carry now, there’s much more freedom on the pitch, so we’ve used different systems.
